paths._comment: All paths may use %ENV% or be absolute. root is overridable via CLAUDE_AUTOMATION_ROOT.

monarch._comment: Monarch rebranded domains in 2025: web app is app.monarch.com, GraphQL is api.monarch.com/graphql. Older app.monarchmoney.com / api.monarchmoney.com still appear in some flows.

selectors._comment: Monarch's DOM changes without notice. These are resilient guesses with fallbacks; VERIFY against the live page (see docs/TESTING.md > 'Refreshing selectors'). monarch-session.mjs tries each candidate in order.

playwright._comment: headlessDefault is overridden to false when prepare_task.ps1 is run with -Interactive.

credentials._comment: Where prepare_task.ps1 looks for secrets. Priority: provider order below. 'env' reads MONARCH_EMAIL / MONARCH_PASSWORD / MONARCH_MFA_SECRET / MONARCH_TOKEN.

session._comment: How long a successful validation is trusted before forcing a full browser re-check. Token fast-path is always attempted.

notifications._comment: Any combination may be enabled. Failures always notify if at least one channel is enabled. Set 'notifyOnSuccess' true for heartbeat confirmations.

cowork._comment: How Launch-ClaudeCowork.ps1 starts Cowork. See docs/COWORK_INTEGRATION.md. exePathCandidates are tried in order; first existing wins. promptDelivery describes how the main prompt reaches Cowork.
